solutions.title: Separate row, column, and box scans
solutions.strategy: Check each row, each column, and each 3x3 box independently with a small seen set.

timeComplexity.explanation: The board size is fixed at 9x9, so the number of inspected cells is bounded; generalized to n cells, the work is linear in the cell count.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Each seen set stores at most nine digits and is discarded after each unit scan.

solutions.title: Single pass bitmasks
solutions.strategy: Scan the board once and store used digits in row, column, and box bitmasks.

timeComplexity.explanation: The fixed-size board has 81 cells, so runtime is bounded; generalized to n cells, each cell is processed once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: There are 27 integer masks regardless of the number of filled cells.
